# Accessibility & Child UX Requirements Checklist: Entre na Roda Web App

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, clarity, and completeness regarding accessibility, suitability for children aged 8 to 10, and acceptance criteria precision.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [Link to spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness (Accessibility & Child UX)

- [ ] CHK001 Are contrast ratio requirements explicitly specified to meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards across all text and background elements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Are touch target size requirements quantified with specific minimum dimensions (e.g., >= 44x44px) to accommodate children's motor dexterity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Are typography size requirements defined with specific minimum thresholds (e.g., >= 18px) suitable for readers aged 8 to 10 in varying reading development stages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are non-text visual elements (emojis, icons, illustrations) required to have clear alternative representations or visual redundancy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity & Appropriateness (Ages 8-10)

- [ ] CHK005 Are sentence length and vocabulary complexity constraints explicitly defined for instructional texts and feedback to suit 8-10 year olds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the behavior and fallback requirement clearly specified for browsers lacking support for the Web Speech API (`speechSynthesis`)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements prohibiting competitive elements (ranking, timers, pressure, loss of lives) explicitly documented and unambiguous? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 Are screen orientation and viewport boundaries (360px to 1440px without horizontal scrolling) specified with measurable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality & Measurability

- [ ] CHK009 Are acceptance criteria for the pedagogical feedback mechanism (acerto, pista, segunda tentativa, explicação) objectively verifiable? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements for color-independent state signaling (e.g., using both text and icons for success/error) explicitly defined? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements for keyboard navigation and focus management fully specified for all interactive button components? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Are data privacy and session storage constraints (zero personal data collection) documented with clear boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]

## Edge Cases & Exception Flows

- [ ] CHK013 Is the system's behavior specified when a user refreshes or reloads mid-session in terms of session memory reset? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for dual-user interaction on a single shared device in classroom settings? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
